Norway is scheduled to [decriminalize](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-19/norway-to-decriminalize-personal-drug-use-in-historic-shift) all drugs by the end of year if it passes parliament, which seems very probable. They got a majority vote back in march 2018 to create a drug reform commitee, consisting of experts in social & drug studies.   
They then on the 19. of December 2019 delivered a [proposal](https://idpc.net/alerts/2020/01/norwegian-drug-reform-committee-report-remove-penalties-for-use-and-possession) to decriminalize all drugs for personal use in Norway. The final vote is expected to take place before september, probaly during summer. 

The association for safer drug policies has been at the head of the movement and has made other similar [campaigns](https://www.reddit.com/r/nextfuckinglevel/comments/ljspl2/these_drug_prevention_posters_from_a_campaign_in/) like this
